attempts.text:
This plan rescues all 11 people with no deferrals. Naukunda shelter is the only designated evacuation point, so Gosaikunda school cannot be used as a drop-off.

- **Myagang elderly (3):** The round trip to Myagang takes 10 minutes and avoids a 150 penalty, so it is worth doing. All three fit in one trip.
- **Gosaikunda (4 injured, 4 children):** Each round trip takes 56 minutes, and the car carries 4. I take the injured first because their penalty is higher. A trip for the children costs 56 minutes and avoids a 240 penalty, so it is also worth doing.

<plan>
drive car1 naukunda-shelter myagang-care-home
load car1 elderly 3
drive car1 myagang-care-home naukunda-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
drive car1 naukunda-shelter gosaikunda-school
load car1 injured 4
drive car1 gosaikunda-school naukunda-shelter
unload car1 injured 4
drive car1 naukunda-shelter gosaikunda-school
load car1 child 4
drive car1 gosaikunda-school naukunda-shelter
unload car1 child 4
</plan>

COST: 122
